## Checklist

- [ ] The folder is `mods/<id>/` (plugins and themes) or `native/<id>/` (native), named after the id.
- [ ] `mod.json` is complete; `github` is my own handle.
- [ ] `id`, `name` and `version` match the package's own manifest.
- [ ] Plugins: `permissions` and `hosts` match `manifest.json`, and the script uses every permission it asks for.
- [ ] At least one screenshot in `screenshots/`, 16:10, at least 640 px wide, under 1.5 MB.
- [ ] I made this, or I have the right to share it under the licence in `mod.json`.
- [ ] Updates: I bumped the version, and `changes` says what is new.
- [ ] Native only: `homepage` links the source the payload is built from.

The **Validate mods** check runs on this pull request. A maintainer reviews every mod before merging;
native mods also need the `native-reviewed` label.
